exposure: number of previous vaginal births after cesarean
outcome: Success rate of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
finding: Shorter duration of ruptured membranes and a modified Bishop score ≥ 4 were independently associated with successful TOLAC in grand-multiparous women.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at TOLAC was 37(1/7) ± 3(6/7) weeks in the success group and 38(5/7) ± 3(1/7) weeks in the failure group
